title.narrative: Activity under preparation Early-stage investment knowledge facility

description.narrative: To achieve the goals of Global Gateway, the need to speed up and scale up the collaboration between the EU institutions and the European private sector in specific priority areas has emerged. This action aims to promote and employ the EU private sector¿s and EU research institutions¿ knowledge in different areas through the establishment of an ¿Early-stage Investment Mechanism¿ that will facilitate Global Gateway investments by capitalising on the European entities¿ know-how in project formulation and development worldwide.This facility will provide targeted financial support (tentatively ranging from EUR 0.5 to 2 million) to EU entities for very early-stage project conception in the transport, artificial intelligence, energy and urban development sectors. These transformative areas are considered engines of economic growth and innovation, shaping the future of our planet and, when planned properly, can also help support low-carbon development and build greater climate resilience.The primary aim of the ¿Early-stage Investment Mechanism¿ is to pave the way towards EU private sector investment in partner countries. By providing financial support to the EU private sector for very early-stage (pilot) projects to the benefit of our partner countries but also prepare the ground for investments that are more compatible with the EU private sector offer.This will ultimately contribute to significant infrastructure improvements, business opportunities for the EU private sector, and enhancing economic development, job creation, and regional integration in partner countries.
